title: hyperspectaculR: Artistic visualisation of hyperspectral imaging data
description: Artistic compositions and descriptive summaries from hyperspectral imaging cubes and numeric arrays: radial spectral mandalas, cumulative spectral change, multi-band RGB fusion, exact spectral density, and experimental RMS spectral slope and within-pixel spectral quartiles. Returns composable ggplot objects with explicit validity, display domains and original-rendering provenance. Recording readers, calibration, three-dimensional sculptures and animations are outside this package.
notes: Prepared 0.2.0 development candidate. Not yet published.
